title: Tests must not truncate shared tables
body: Cleanup in API tests must not truncate shared tables. Create a per-test schema with the schema helper and drop it afterwards.

title: Orders tests truncate only the fixture table
body: In orders.test.ts truncate only orders_fixture, never orders itself.

title: API source layering
body: Routes call services; services call repositories. A route never imports a repository.

title: Tests isolate their data
body: Every test creates the rows it reads and removes only those rows.

title: Scope cached state to the signed-in identity
body: Query keys and stores include the organisation id and user id so a second sign-in never sees the first user's data.

title: Set staleTime on queries that feed forms
body: A form seeded from a query needs staleTime so a background refetch does not overwrite what the user typed.

title: Do not keep personal data in mutation state
body: Mutation variables stay in the mutation cache. Reset the mutation after success so a social security number is not retained.

title: Effects run after paint
body: Read layout in useLayoutEffect; useEffect runs after paint and can flash stale layout.

title: Drizzle column names are snake_case in SQL
body: Declare the SQL name as the first argument of the column helper; the property name is only the TypeScript key.

title: Contract changes touch three packages
body: A change to a zod contract needs the web query hooks, the mission-control readers and the API handlers updated together.

title: Mission control reads the order contract
body: mission-control parses orders with the shared contract; a renamed field breaks its dashboard.

title: Sessions are server side
body: Decision: sessions live in the database, not in signed cookies, so they can be revoked.

title: Business days use the facility time zone
body: Compute business days in the facility time zone, never in UTC or the server zone.

title: Use the existing request limits
body: Reuse the request limit wrapper in http/limits; do not add a second allowlist.

title: Fixtures use obviously fake personal data
body: Fixture names and numbers must be plainly fake, never copied from a real record.

title: Truncate everything for speed
body: Truncate all tables between tests to run faster. Truncate truncate truncate.

title: A guess about limits
body: The limits wrapper may be bypassed in tests.

title: Orders module notes
body: The orders module owns order state transitions; other modules call its service.

title: The order contract file
body: order.ts is the single definition of the order shape; both web and mission-control import it.

title: Keep the README command list short
body: List commands, not explanations; link the guide for the rest.
